launches.title: Hexa: Autonomous operations for industrial distributors
launches.tagline: We automate sourcing and quoting. Distributors sell more at higher margins.
launches.body:
Hey everyone, we’re [Ishaan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ishaan-makkar/), [Auri](https://www.linkedin.com/in/aurideep/) and [Mann](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mannpatira/) - cofounders of [Hexa](https://www.hexaagents.com) 👋

\
**TLDR**

Hexa automates sales and procurement for industrial distributors and manufacturers, helping them source parts cheaper and quote faster to grow revenue by over 10%.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_8Knlrk4zwc>

**The Problem**

Mid-market distributors and high-volume manufacturers run everything through legacy ERPs, and those systems still depend on humans to key in every quote, order, and invoice.

Sales reps spend their days reading RFQs from email, PDF, Excel, and fax, then retyping them into the ERP instead of talking to customers.

Quoting takes hours, which means distributors respond slowly and lose 15%+ of revenue each year.

The people who actually know how to run these systems are retiring. Over half the workforce will leave this decade, and the knowledge in their heads walks out with them.

You cannot grow faster than you can hire. Service slows and relationships suffer.

**The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102525&key=user_uploads/2767100/da1b1daf-476d-42f0-a878-007c6012dc36)

Hexa plugs into the systems you already use and brings AI agents natively inside the ERP. No rip-and-replace, live in days.

Hexa watches every channel a request comes in on and runs the full workflow:

* Quoting: Reads the RFQ, matches the right SKU and pricing, and drafts the quote so it is ready to send.
* Order Entry: Matches the incoming PO to the quote, creates the sales order, and writes it into the ERP.
* Procurement & Finance: Sources out-of-stock items at the best cost, then reconciles AP/AR and catches discrepancies humans miss.

Reps review and approve instead of hours of admin. Response times go from hours to minutes, win rates increase.

**The Team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102525&key=user_uploads/2767100/2907d734-5902-4a91-95f7-9cea885197f0)

Ishaan (CEO) - Grew up around manufacturing; his family runs one of India’s largest paper producers. He scaled a previous B2B startup to 5,000+ users, then worked at a manufacturer building the exact automations Hexa sells today.

Mann (CTO) - Studied Computer Science at Imperial. Worked at Bloomberg as an ML engineer building graph neural networks for financial derivatives, and at Autodesk building software for manufacturers.

Auri (COO) – Worked in the Private Equity team at KKR where he covered distributors, the exact buyers Hexa sells to. Prior to this worked in the technology investing team at Apax. Former U14 England chess player.

We’ve known each other for over a decade, from the same school and town, and now live together.

**Our ask:**

If you know an owner of an industrial distributor or a VP of Sales or Operations, please reach out. We have a 15% referral bonus!

<https://www.hexaagents.com/referral>

launches.title: Wato: a shared AI workspace for teams
launches.tagline: Permissioned tools, cloud agents, automations, and shared workflows for the AI apps your team already uses.
launches.body:
Website: <https://www.watolabs.com>

**TL;DR: Wato is a shared AI workspace for teams.** It helps companies keep their AI workflows, company knowledge, integrations, agent sessions, and agent-generated work inside the organization instead of scattered across individual chats, local files, or personal AI accounts. All of this is done via one, unified MCP.

**Ask:** If your team is using AI agents for engineering, ops, sales, research, finance, support, or internal workflows, we’d love to see how we can help. We’re especially interested in teams setting up MCP/tools, sharing prompts or workflows internally, launching cloud agents, or trying to preserve useful agent context across the company.

**The problem:** Teams are already using AI for real company workflows: debugging production issues, preparing sales calls, analyzing customer data, updating models, drafting client deliverables, and searching across internal systems.

But the work usually disappears into individual tools and accounts. The context, prompts, decisions, files, and tool setups that made the output useful are hard for the next teammate to find, trust, or reuse.

**What Wato does:** Wato gives each team a shared, permissioned AI workspace.

Teams can connect approved integrations and MCP tools, build shared memory, publish reusable skills, run collaborative cloud agent sessions, host live artifacts and dashboards, and trace tool calls across the organization.

The goal is simple: **when one person or agent learns something useful, builds a workflow, or creates an artifact, that knowledge should stay with the company and become available to the right people.**

**What’s included:**

\- **Team memory** for durable company knowledge agents can reuse

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102479&key=user_uploads/3203486/64ae52b1-6599-49c7-9e99-297e4e71a9ae)

\- **Approved MCP tools and integrations** with org, team, per-user, and tool-level permissions

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102479&key=user_uploads/3203486/e8673b85-1e38-456a-ad60-d5d90ed2fe80)

\- **Reusable skills and workflows** library so teams don’t prompt from scratch every time

\- **Cloud agent sessions** that teammates can view, continue, and collaborate on, with access to a desktop, computer use, filesystem, and environment set up.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102479&key=user_uploads/3203486/b3da2993-c84f-4347-ad8a-46fea54ee809)

\- **Automations** that can be created from connector triggers or run on a specific cadence.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102479&key=user_uploads/3203486/edc32ad1-ae2e-42ef-9014-0782e8112464)

\- **Live artifacts and dashboards** that can use approved company data

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102479&key=user_uploads/3203486/700f9d35-6150-4012-b58c-e56b54b39c30)

\- **Tool-call tracing and audit logs** so teams can see what agents accessed and produced

Wato also works with the AI tools teams already use, including Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, and other MCP-compatible environments. You add the Wato MCP once, authenticate with your company account, and your agent gets access to the right team memory, skills, and approved tools.

**Backstory:** We started working on Wato after seeing the same problem across institutions adopting these tools like Claude or Codex. A super user would figure out a great workflow, debugging process, research method, client-prep flow, or tool setup, but the useful part would end up stuck in a chat thread, local file, or personal account. Then the next person would start over.

At the same time, companies didn’t want every employee independently managing MCP configs, tool permissions, prompts, and scattered agent instructions. They needed a shared layer between the company and the AI tools its people use to normalize AI use.

That became Wato.

**We’d love to talk to teams who are:**

\- **using agents** across engineering, ops, sales, research, finance, support, or internal workflows

\- setting up **MCP servers or internal tools** for agent use

\- trying to **share prompts, skills, playbooks, or workflows** across a team

\- creating AI-generated **dashboards**, docs, reports, or **artifacts** that need to be shared securely

\- worried about **company knowledge** disappearing into personal AI accounts

\- thinking about **permissions**, **review**, **tracing**, or **governance** for agent work

If this sounds familiar, and I’m guessing it does for a lot of you, we’d love to show you Wato and get feedback.

Website: <https://www.watolabs.com>  

Twitter/X: <https://www.x.com/watolabs>

launches.title: Zenbu - The extensible IDE for managing coding agents
launches.tagline: An IDE for coding agents, shaped by the way you work
launches.body:
Hi, I’m Rob, the founder of Zenbu

## The problem

Coding agents are changing how software gets built, but they also create a new kind of complexity: running several agents in parallel, reviewing changes nobody wrote by hand, verifying their work, switching contexts, and keeping track of the codebase.

## The solution

Zenbu is an IDE for managing that complexity.

It’s built on top on Pi, the minimal, customizable coding agent. Around Pi, Zenbu adds an extensible IDE where everything is a plugin, including the tools for managing agents.

![uploaded image](/media/?key=user_uploads/3026245/3318eb29-4238-42d0-a338-9543b7e1fffd)

That matters because every developer and company works with agents differently. Instead of forcing one workflow, Zenbu lets the best solutions get built as plugins by developers and teams with their own needs. Over time, the best ways to work with agents become part of the shared foundation everyone can build on.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZUbY8zdv7Rc>

## About me

I build developer tools. I co-authored React Scan, an open source tool now at 22k GitHub stars and 800k weekly installs. I also worked at Vercel, where I joined the Next.js team and built an internal development environment.

Zenbu is the IDE I wanted for working with coding agents every day.

## Asks

I’d love to hear from developers who use coding agents seriously, especially if you customize your setup.

Try it at [zenbu.dev](http://zenbu.dev) and tell me what you’d change first: [rob@zenbu.dev](mailto:rob@zenbu.dev)

✅ $199 — HSA/FSA eligible

🔗 **Start monitoring:** <http://siphoxhealth.com/glp-monitoring>

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102471&key=user_uploads/520037/2235ba82-46fe-42ad-a38b-c5fb7f65c2cd)

### 🔨 Why We Built This

# We're Getting Into the GLP Game — But Not With a Me-Too Product

30 million Americans are currently on GLP drugs. That number is going up. Access is getting easier, prices are falling, and the longevity research on low-dose GLP therapy is compelling enough that it's not hard to imagine most adults cycling on and off these medications eventually, not just for weight loss, but for metabolic health and lifespan.

There are plenty of places to buy Ozempic, but the monitoring and optimization infrastructure is not there yet. The biology of GLP therapy is more complicated than the weight loss headline suggests:

🚫 **Muscle loss is hidden by the scale.** Fast weight loss often means lean mass loss, not just fat. Standard weight tracking can't tell the difference.

🚫 **Side effects are downstream signals.** Fatigue, brain fog, hair shedding, and constipation aren't random — they're often markers of caloric under-fueling, nutrient depletion, or dehydration pressure that bloodwork would catch early.

🚫 **Prescribers don't monitor the full picture.** Most GLP patients get minimal follow-up labs, if any. HbA1c, ApoB, ferritin, B12, testosterone, thyroid — none of these are standard-of-care during treatment.

🚫 **Weight alone is a bad success metric.** Losing 24 lbs while losing 6 lbs of muscle and depleting your ferritin is not the same as losing 24 lbs of fat.

# The Solution: A Monitoring Loop Built for GLP Therapy

We've served 50,000+ users with at-home blood testing. GLP users are a distinct population with distinct needs, so we built a product specifically for them. The SiPhox GLP Monitoring Panel connects labs, body composition, and symptom tracking into one continuous loop so you can see what the drug is actually doing to your biology and course-correct before small problems become bigger ones.

---

### 💡 What You Get

**✅ 40+ Lab Markers — GLP-Specific Panel**

Not a generic wellness panel. Built around the markers that matter when appetite, weight, hydration, and body composition are actively changing:

* **Metabolism:** HbA1c, eAG, C-Peptide
* **Lipids & heart:** ApoB, LDL, HDL, Triglycerides, hsCRP
* **Liver:** ALT, AST, ALP, bilirubin, albumin
* **Kidney & hydration:** BUN, creatinine, eGFR, BUN:Cr ratio
* **Thyroid:** TSH, Free T4
* **Hormones:** Testosterone (total + free + %), SHBG, cortisol
* **Nutrition:** Vitamin D, B12, folate, ferritin, iron studies (Iron, UIBC, TIBC, Iron Saturation), total protein

**✅ Painless At-Home Collection**

Collected via our Easydraw arm patch, no venous draw, no finger prick, no lab visit. Mail it back, and the results appear in your dashboard.

**✅ Body-Composition Scanning**

In-app scanner tracks fat loss vs. lean mass preservation between tests.

**✅ GLP Tolerance Score**

A composite score built from labs, body comp, and symptom check-ins. Tracks how well your body is handling therapy at each stage: baseline → titration → maintenance.

**✅ Symptom & Side-Effect Tracking**

Track fatigue, brain fog, hair shedding, GI issues, and muscle soreness between tests. Connects subjective experience to objective lab data.

**✅ Detailed Analysis & Personalized Insights**

Interpret what's moving in the right direction, what deserves a conversation with your prescriber, and what to adjust in diet, training, or supplementation built around your specific results.

🔗 **Start monitoring:** <http://siphoxhealth.com/glp-monitoring>

---

---

### 📈 Why Now?

GLP drugs are the fastest-growing drug class in history. Next-gen peptides like retatrutide, orforglipron, cagrilintide are coming. The longevity use case is expanding the addressable population well beyond obesity treatment. And monitoring has not kept pace with any of it.

Most patients are flying blind. Prescribers don't have the bandwidth for individualized follow-up. Labs are ordered inconsistently, if at all. No one is connecting weight, body composition, symptoms, and biomarkers in a single continuous view.

\_____________________________________________________________________\_

### 🏢 For Businesses: White-Label the GLP Monitoring

Running a GLP prescribing platform, a metabolic health clinic, a wellness app, or a supplement brand with a GLP-adjacent audience? You can white-label or co-brand the entire monitoring program.

**What the partner program gives you:**

✅ White-label or co-branded kit and dashboard under your brand

✅ Full panel access + API integration for embedding results in your own product

✅ Partner dashboard to track your clients' health journeys and customize next steps with real biomarker data

✅ Pre/post protocol testing to prove efficacy and reduce churn

✅ CLIA/CAP-accredited lab processing — same quality as traditional venous draws

✅ Account management, biomarker interpretation training, and marketing support

Patients are 3x more likely to stay engaged with a health program backed by real biomarker data.

🔗 **Partner inquiry:** [siphoxhealth.com/partner](https://siphoxhealth.com/partner)

\_____________________________________________________________________\_

---

### 🤝 For Health Coaches: Refer and Earn

If you work with people on GLP therapy as a health coach, personal trainer, or content creator, our affiliate program is built for you.

No cost to join. No hidden fees. Your referrals get a better monitoring product and better outcomes; you get a meaningful revenue stream.

🔗 **Join the affiliate program:** [siphoxhealth.com/affiliate-program](https://siphoxhealth.com/affiliate-program)

\_____________________________________________________________________\_

### About SiPhox Health

SiPhox Health, backed by Khosla Ventures, Intel Capital, and Y Combinator, is a full-stack home blood testing company founded at MIT. We've tested 1M+ biomarkers across 50,000+ users.
